# Play — Zip It

- SudokuPad: [Zip It on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Zip It on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Zipper lines and Dutch whispers are exported as **cosmetic** coloured lines (purple 0.3 wide, orange 0.2 wide), because f-puzzles
has no native zipper or Dutch-whisper entry that I could confirm SudokuPad reads. So the apps draw the lines but don't enforce
them. The rules text is the authority. I have not opened the links in a browser myself.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, given, solution).
